pullRequests.title: docs: short README and docs sorted into folders
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: docs/readme-cleanup
pullRequests.body:
Before
A long README with setup steps and hand-updated progress tables, and docs in one flat folder with mixed-case names.
After
A short README like Lombyte's: the OpenRAC logo with " decompilation project" under it, a code badge and a note for each version, quick setup, credits and license. Progress comes only from the ByteMatch badges, so the README needs no commit when progress moves. The details moved to docs/, now sorted into docs/build, docs/contributing, docs/game, docs/research/us and…
